name: Meeting Builder
description: Builds and maintains real Meeting notes from Outlook Calendar activity -- the real Hermes cron job behind this is meeting-capture-recurring (every 30 minutes), running the meeting-capture Skill.

steps.name: Fetch Meetings
steps.description: Pulls new Outlook Calendar meetings since the last capture point.

steps.name: Resolve Meeting Folder
steps.description: Resolves/creates the meeting's own folder via vault_manager.py's real id-based find/create (REQ-SB-80's template-driven writer, 2026-08-26 rebuild) -- identity is the calendar event's own real id, never the folder name, so a rename or reschedule can never leave a meeting stuck under a stale name the way the old name-is-identity scheme could. A recurring series gets its own concept note plus a nested Recurrences/ folder per real occurrence, sorted by its most recent occurrence date; the series' own filename never carries a date.

steps.name: Build Attendees
steps.description: Creates/links a Person note for each real attendee, reusing the same Person-creation primitive as email capture, deduplicated against existing People.

steps.name: Link to Thread
steps.description: Cross-references the meeting against a matching email Thread when one exists.
